about.title: Lindsay Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: When a faulty product injures someone in Lindsay, the aftermath can feel confusing — was it a bad part, a missing warning label, or something else entirely? Under California law, injured people often don't have to prove a manufacturer was careless; strict liability can apply if the product itself was defective and that defect caused harm. That covers design flaws, manufacturing errors, and inadequate warnings. Liability can extend beyond the manufacturer to distributors and retailers who sold the item. In a farming and residential community like Lindsay, defective products show up everywhere — agricultural equipment, household tools, vehicle parts, appliances. We handle product liability cases on a contingency basis, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. The first step is often simple: hold onto the product exactly as it was when the injury happened, and let our team evaluate the rest.
commonInjuries: Burns from malfunctioning appliances or equipment
Lacerations from defective tools or machinery parts
Crush or amputation injuries from farm equipment failures
Fractures from collapsing furniture or structures
Electrical shock from faulty wiring or devices

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Path
items.desc: California often allows injured people to focus on proving a defect and injury rather than proving negligence, which can streamline what needs to be shown.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, giving us more avenues to pursue accountability on your behalf.

items.title: No Cost Unless You Recover

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury — don't repair, discard, or alter it. The product itself is often the most important piece of evidence in a defect claim. Our team can advise on safe storage and next steps.

items.question: Does Lindsay's rural and agricultural setting affect these claims?
items.answer: It can. Many defect cases in areas like Lindsay involve farm equipment, irrigation tools, or machinery used on residential or agricultural property. The same strict liability principles apply regardless of where the product was used.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability approach generally focuses on whether the product was defective and whether that defect caused your injury, not on proving carelessness. Our team can walk you through how this applies to your specific situation.
